description: This file defines the 'DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator' class, which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It contains logic to configure menu items based on the current request's mode, specifically adjusting the screen to show either the general leave list or the user's personal leave list within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the menu screens for detailed leave requests, dynamically switching screens based on user mode (e.g., 'my-leave') within the leave management module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu screen based on the current request parameter 'mode'. If 'mode' equals 'my-leave', it switches the screen to 'viewMyLeaveList'; otherwise, it defaults to 'viewLeaveList'.
